Remote Assistance Resource Set Remote Assistance Info
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/remoteAssistance

Retrieves information about the Remote Assistance option configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. Using this option, you can allow Zscaler Support to access your organization’s ZIA Admin Portal for a specified time period to troubleshoot issues. To learn more, see Enabling Remote Assistance.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
